conventions.read_unc: figure_read only: half line thickness (pixel reads) or the extraction precision (vector reads) in data units; not the SE band
conventions.acceptance: exact kinds (table_exact, released_file_exact, computed_from_release, vector_figure_exact): |mean_repro - value| <= 2*sqrt(SE_repro^2 + SE_pub^2) with the target's own SE_pub (se, else sd_at_argmin / sd / sd_at_x over sqrt(n_reps), else 0); figure readings (every other kind): |mean_repro - value| <= read_unc + 2*sqrt(SE_repro^2 + SE_pub^2), SE_pub = the stated SE where the source states one, else SE_pub := SE_repro (target_se_from 'assumed_equal_to_ours'); n_reps >= published. pass_strict (recorded beside pass) uses SE_pub = 0 where the band is unstated.
conventions.doe_only_below: evaluation counts below this value are inside the initial design; skip them (None = no DoE-only prefix)
conventions.values_shape: per entry: list_of_records | dict_key_to_list_of_records | dict_task_to_single_record | dict_of_scalar_maps
conventions.lassobench_pickles: compare at x_logged with the statistic running-min of the across-rep mean raw loss; never with mean best-so-far
conventions.vector_figure_exact: mean read from the vector PDF (precision ~1e-5 in data units) whose shaded band is stated (caption or text) to be one standard error of the mean: se = band half-width; judged like an exact value, |ours - value| <= 2 * sqrt(SE_ours^2 + se^2)
conventions.x_eval_offset: the plot x of a record is n; the harness compares at n + x_eval_offset evaluations. 0 when the plot counts evaluations from 1, 1 when it indexes them from 0 (x = k is the best after k + 1 evaluations)
conventions.gate: entry- or record-level boolean; gate: false = informative (rows computed and reported, never a pass or fail). Any other value, or no key, = gate
conventions.sd_at_argmin: lassobench_pkl__* records: SD across repetitions at the arg-min column j* <= x_logged of the running minimum (the column the published value comes from); SE_pub = sd_at_argmin / sqrt(n_reps). sd_at_x (the SD at x_logged) is kept for the record only
conventions.target_se_assumed: a figure reading whose band meaning is unstated still has a sampling error of its own; it is taken equal to ours (same estimator, equal repetitions), recorded per row as target_se_from 'assumed_equal_to_ours' (round 2, R2-3). After R2-8/R2-9 the assumption is needed only where no band meaning is stated (Hvarfner Fig. 7, incl. its TuRBO-1 / CMA-ES / SAASBO curves) or where a stated band cannot be read (Xu Fig. 6 at 50, 150, 250, 300; recorded per record as se_from_rule); the visual reads gabo__ackley_sphere__fig3, hesbo_ei__branin_D100__fig1 and saasbo__hartmann6_D100__fig3 have no harness benchmark
conventions.objective_version_allowance: top-level key objective_version_allowance: tolerance += delta_b * |value| for the targets listed in its target_benchmark map; pass_strict uses delta = 0
conventions.se_from: record key: how a stated SE_pub was obtained when it is not the plotted band itself (band_sd_over_sqrt_n: band = 1 SD, SE_pub = half-width / sqrt(n_reps))
